pointsOfInterest.name: The Jedi Enclave Ruins
pointsOfInterest.description: The ancient ruins of a Jedi Enclave that existed thousands of years ago. A place of pilgrimage for Jedi Seekers and those drawn to the Force.

pointsOfInterest.name: The Kinrath Cave
pointsOfInterest.description: A dangerous cave system inhabited by kinrath creatures. Contains valuable Force-sensitive crystals but extremely dangerous.

pointsOfInterest.name: Abandoned Rebel Base
pointsOfInterest.description: An early Rebel Alliance base that was abandoned after its discovery by the Empire. May still contain valuable intelligence.

pointsOfInterest.name: Dantooine Settlement
pointsOfInterest.description: A peaceful agrarian settlement where those seeking a simple life away from the galactic core make their home.
